stockAnalysis.title: {{symbol}} Stock Analysis
stockAnalysis.calculationDescription: Calculation: use TTM EPS with a target P/E of {{low}}–{{high}}, then add cash per share of {{cash}}. The watch range applies a 20% margin of safety to the lower end of fair value. Because debt per share is unavailable, the cash adjustment is only a scenario assumption and does not represent net cash.
stockAnalysis.lossMakingDescription: Current TTM EPS is {{eps}}. Earnings are negative, so a target P/E cannot produce a meaningful fair value. Consider P/S, EV/Sales, cash levels and the path to profitability instead.
stockAnalysis.pegWarning: PEG is invalid or identical to P/E. This valuation did not use PEG to raise the target multiple; check the backend field mapping.
stockAnalysis.cashBufferDescription: Cash per share is {{cash}}, approximately {{percentage}} of the current share price.
stockAnalysis.disclaimer: This range is produced by a rule-based model using available snapshot data. It is neither a real-time quote nor investment advice. Decisions should also consider earnings growth, debt, cash flow, the industry cycle and the latest announcements.

dashboard.etfSubtitle: Includes moving-average distance and volume confirmation

etfNote.RSI_HOT: RSI is in the overheated range
etfNote.MA20_EXTENDED: Price is materially away from the 20-day average
etfNote.HIGH_VOLUME: Volume is above the recent five-day average
etfNote.NORMAL: Indicators are within their normal ranges

rules.maDescription: A larger distance from MA20 means price is farther from its short-to-medium-term balance. Combined with a high RSI, it can indicate overheating.
rules.volumeDescription: Volume ratio = current volume / five-day average volume. A ratio above 1.2 with a price rise indicates stronger participation.
rules.combinationDescription: The strongest combination is usually rising price, expanding volume and increasing distance; high distance with weak volume warrants caution.

messages.ETF_OVERHEATED: {{ticker}}: RSI is {{rsi}} and price is {{deviation}} above MA20; short-term conditions are overheated.
messages.ETF_OVERSOLD: {{ticker}}: RSI is {{rsi}}; momentum is weak and in the oversold watch zone.
messages.ETF_VOLUME_CONFIRMED: {{ticker}}: price rose with a {{volumeRatio}} volume ratio, confirming the move.
messages.ETF_LOW_VOLUME_EXTENSION: {{ticker}}: price is {{deviation}} above MA20 but volume ratio is only {{volumeRatio}}; beware of low-volume chasing.
messages.EXTREME_GREED: CNN Fear & Greed is {{score}}; sentiment is in extreme greed.
messages.EXTREME_FEAR: CNN Fear & Greed is {{score}}; sentiment is in extreme fear.
messages.NO_ALERTS: No overheating, oversold, volume-confirmed rise or low-volume extension alert is active.
messages.SUMMARY_WITH_SENTIMENT: CNN Fear & Greed is {{score}}; among observed ETFs, {{up}} rose and {{down}} fell.
messages.SUMMARY_WITHOUT_SENTIMENT: CNN sentiment data is unavailable; among observed ETFs, {{up}} rose and {{down}} fell.

marketSummary.STRONG_BUT_OVERHEATED: Risk appetite is strong, but sentiment is overheated
marketSummary.HOT_BUT_DIVERGING: Sentiment is hot while price momentum diverges
marketSummary.FEAR_WITH_RECOVERY: Prices are recovering amid fearful sentiment
marketSummary.WEAK_AND_FEARFUL: Risk appetite is weak and sentiment is fearful
marketSummary.BULLISH_NON_EXTREME: Momentum is bullish without extreme sentiment
marketSummary.BEARISH: Momentum is bearish; manage downside risk
marketSummary.DIVERGING: Market direction is mixed; await a clearer signal

execution.HIGH_RISK: Multiple risk conditions are active. Reduce chasing and high-volatility exposure until RSI, MA distance or volume normalizes.
execution.SELECTIVE: Some risk conditions are active. Stay selective and confirm volume and MA distance before adding exposure.
execution.BULLISH: ETF momentum is broadly bullish with no major risk trigger. A bullish bias is reasonable with defined risk limits.
execution.DEFENSIVE: ETF momentum is broadly weak without a confirmed reversal. Keep exposure conservative and await a volume-backed recovery.
execution.NEUTRAL: Data is limited or direction is mixed. Maintain neutral exposure until price-volume signals become clearer.

dashboard.noUpcomingEvents: No confirmed market-moving events in the next 14 days.
